fields.description: Bashayer combines villas, apartments, penthouses and townhomes along Hudayriyat Island’s northern waterfront. Shared parks and leisure facilities connect the neighbourhood with its planned waterfront promenade.

overview: The December 2025 launch described 157 villas and 330 residences in two terraced buildings. A July 2026 announcement reported the final 300-residence phase sold out; this is historical release information, not current availability.
research.locationNote: Bashayer occupies the northern waterfront of Hudayriyat Island, Abu Dhabi, facing Al Bateen and the city skyline.
research.priceNote: Current one-bedroom apartments are advertised from AED 2.5 million. Earlier villa guides differ: factsheet AED 7.2 million; Property Finder AED 6 million. Confirm the selected release.

research.handoverNote: Current targets: villas Q1 2030; apartments Q2 2030. Original villa calendar: March 2029; Property Finder: September 2028. Confirm the release.
